definitions.explanation: A person with exceptional intellectual ability or talent, especially in academics. Carries a positive connotation of natural brilliance.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{学校|がっこう}→学校：00055_gakkou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧な{秀才|しゅうさい}だった。
examples.english: He was a well-known prodigy even at school.

examples.japanese: ⟦{努力|どりょく}→努力：03490_doryoku⟧⟦だけでなく→〜だけでなく：18373_dakedenaku⟧、⟦{生|う}まれつき→生まれつき：21201_umaretsuki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{秀才|しゅうさい}だ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦こそ→こそ：12731_koso⟧⟦{成|な}し{遂|と}げられた→成し遂げる：12632_nashitogeru⟧⟦{成果|せいか}→成果：06745_seika⟧だ。
examples.english: It was an achievement only possible because he is a born genius, not just hardworking.

notes:
USAGE:
Primarily refers to academic or intellectual brilliance rather than artistic or athletic talent. Often used to describe students who excel in school.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {秀才|しゅうさい}⟦タイプ→タイプ：01534_taipu⟧ (the prodigy type)
- {秀才|しゅうさい}⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧ (of a scholarly disposition)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧: genius — implies even higher, almost superhuman ability
- ⟦{凡人|ぼんじん}→凡人：18298_bonjin⟧: ordinary person — the opposite of {秀才|しゅうさい}
- {英才|えいさい}: gifted person — more formal, often used in compounds like ⟦{英才教育|えいさいきょういく}→英才教育：18469_eisaikyouiku⟧
